Graphics Cards — Power Your Game. Fuel Your Creativity.

A great GPU is the heart of any high-performance PC build. Whether you’re dominating in competitive gaming, rendering complex 3D scenes, editing 4K videos, or diving into AI workloads, TechArc has the perfect graphics card for your needs and budget.

Explore the latest NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 Series — starting with the RTX 5060 and RTX 5060 Ti for smooth 1080p and 1440p gaming, stepping up to the RTX 5070 and RTX 5070 Ti for high-refresh 1440p dominance, all the way to the RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 for uncompromising 4K and beyond. Powered by DLSS 4 and next-gen ray tracing, the RTX 50 series sets a new standard for gaming and content creation performance.

Prefer Team Red? Our AMD Radeon RX 9000 Series brings exceptional value and raw performance to every build. The RX 9060 XT is perfect for competitive 1080p gaming, while the RX 9070 and RX 9070 XT deliver outstanding 1440p performance. For those chasing 4K excellence, the RX 9080 and RX 9090 push AMD to new heights — all backed by FSR technology for ultra-smooth gameplay across every resolution.

Choose from top AIB brands including ASUS, MSI, Gigabyte, Zotac, Sapphire, and Inno3D — each offering unique cooling solutions, factory overclocks, and premium build quality. Whether you need a compact single-fan card or a triple-slot beast with RGB lighting, we have it all.

From budget-friendly entry-level GPUs to flagship powerhouses, TechArc offers competitive prices, authentic products, and fast delivery across Pakistan. Upgrade your build today and experience the difference a great GPU makes.
